description: Now that nothing in the runtime path imports the ML/RL code (FEAT-002), physically delete the entire ML ensemble, the RL agent, the RL-dependent smart-exit layer, the checkpoint training/retraining scripts, and the optional heavy data layers (sentiment/FinBERT, alternative data). Prune the orphaned configuration classes and heavy dependencies. This is the 'fully remove' step the user asked for. Depends on FEAT-002 (rewiring must land first, otherwise deletions break imports).

Keep enable_regime_detection, enable_multi_timeframe, enable_news_filter, enable_multi_pair, enable_dashboard, enable_auto_optimizer, paper_trading, interval_seconds, log_level.

Grep the whole python_bridge/ for any lingering references to the removed symbols/paths and fix them: 'models.', 'EnsembleManager', 'RLAgent', 'PositionState', 'ExitAction', 'SmartExit', 'AutoRetrainer', 'SentimentAnalyzer', 'AlternativeDataFetcher', 'MODEL_DIR', 'TransformerConfig', 'LSTMConfig', 'RLConfig', 'RetrainConfig', 'EnsembleConfig'. In python_bridge/requirements.txt: remove torch, transformers, and hmmlearn (used only by removed ML/regime-HMM code -- verify regime_detector.py does not import hmmlearn before removing; if regime_detector still uses hmmlearn keep it). Remove any tree-boosting deps that were implied only by the deleted gradient_boost/catboost models. Keep pandas, numpy, scikit-learn (only if still imported by retained code -- verify), ta, requests, websocket-client (if bridge uses it), schedule (only if still used), pytest, yfinance, feedparser (news calendar), beautifulsoup4 (only if still used).

Verify regime_detector.py and risk_manager.py imports after pruning: run the AST parse again and a targeted import of strategies.regime_detector and strategies.risk_manager to ensure removed deps are not referenced.
